sections.theory:
Example 7.1

An electrical firm manufactures light bulbs that have a length of life that is approximately normally distributed with a mean of 812 hours and a standard deviation of 40 hours. Test the hypothesis that μ = 812 hours against the alternative μ ≠ 812 hours if a random sample of 36 bulbs has an average life of 800 hours. Use a 5% level of significance.

Solution:

i. Null hypothesis H_0:\mu=812

Alternative hypothesis H_1:\mu\neq 812

ii. Significance level α = 0.05

iii. Test statistic to be used here is; Z=\frac{\overline{X}-\mu}{\sigma/\sqrt{n}}

iv. Calculation: Given n = 36, \overline{X}=800, σ = 40

$\text{Hence } Z=\frac{800-812}{40/\sqrt{36}}=\frac{-12}{40/6}=\frac{-12\times 6}{40}=-1.8$

v. Critical region:

Here the test is two sided, so α/2 = 0.025 Now 0.5 − 0.025 = 0.4750 search this value in the body of the area table of standard normal distribution which correspond to Z_{\alpha/2}=Z_{0.05}=1.96.

Thus reject H_0 if Z ≤ − 1.96 or Z ≥ 1.96.

$\text{Hence } Z=\frac{800-812}{40/\sqrt{36}}=\frac{-12}{40/6}=\frac{-12\times 6}{40}=-1.8$

v. فیصلہ کن علاقہ:

یہاں جانچ دو طرفہ ہے، لہٰذا α/2 = 0.025۔ اب 0.5 − 0.025 = 0.4750؛ یہ قیمت معیاری نارمل تقسیم کے رقبے کے جدول کے متن میں تلاش کریں جو Z_{\alpha/2}=Z_{0.05}=1.96 کے مطابق ہے۔

لہٰذا H_0 کو رد کریں اگر Z ≤ − 1.96 یا Z ≥ 1.96۔

sections.content:
Example 7.1

An electrical firm manufactures light bulbs that have a length of life that is approximately normally distributed with a mean of 812 hours and a standard deviation of 40 hours. Test the hypothesis that μ = 812 hours against the alternative μ ≠ 812 hours if a random sample of 36 bulbs has an average life of 800 hours. Use a 5% level of significance.

Solution:

i. Null hypothesis H_0:\mu=812

Alternative hypothesis H_1:\mu\neq 812

ii. Significance level α = 0.05

iii. Test statistic to be used here is; Z=\frac{\overline{X}-\mu}{\sigma/\sqrt{n}}

iv. Calculation: Given n = 36, \overline{X}=800, σ = 40

$\text{Hence } Z=\frac{800-812}{40/\sqrt{36}}=\frac{-12}{40/6}=\frac{-12\times 6}{40}=-1.8$

v. Critical region:

Here the test is two sided, so α/2 = 0.025 Now 0.5 − 0.025 = 0.4750 search this value in the body of the area table of standard normal distribution which correspond to Z_{\alpha/2}=Z_{0.05}=1.96.

Thus reject H_0 if Z ≤ − 1.96 or Z ≥ 1.96.
